packageRules.description: The loong64 lane pins go1.26.4 on purpose: go1.27.0 miscompiles this package for LoongArch (golang/go#81000), established on real silicon. Renovate has reopened a bump of that pin repeatedly and it is red every time. MEASURED on 2026-09-28: the fix, CL 820040, wraps the Cvt*Fto* rules in MOVWfpgp/MOVVfpgp, and 1.27.1's LOONG64.rules still reads (Cvt64Fto32 ...) => (TRUNCDW ...) exactly as 1.26.4 does -- the CL is not in the release. Unpinning is a human decision that belongs with the comment in ci.yml, not a dependency update.
